import heapq


def pass_route(
    n: int,
    edges: list[list[int]],
    stations: list[list[int]],
    prices: list[int],
) -> int:
    k = len(prices)
    mask_all = (1 << k) - 1

    adj: list[list[tuple[int, int, int]]] = [[] for _ in range(n)]
    for u, v, cost, zone in edges:
        if u == v:
            continue
        zbit = 0 if zone == -1 else (1 << zone)
        adj[u].append((v, cost, zbit))
        adj[v].append((u, cost, zbit))

    sell_mask = [0] * n
    for stop, z in stations:
        sell_mask[stop] |= 1 << z

    offers: list[list[tuple[int, int]]] = [[] for _ in range(n)]
    for stop in range(n):
        sm = sell_mask[stop]
        if sm:
            offers[stop] = [
                (1 << z, prices[z]) for z in range(k) if sm & (1 << z)
            ]

    total_states = n << k
    shift = total_states.bit_length()
    state_mask = (1 << shift) - 1

    inf = 1 << 60
    dist = [inf] * total_states
    dist[0] = 0
    heap = [0]
    target = n - 1

    heappop = heapq.heappop
    heappush = heapq.heappush

    while heap:
        item = heappop(heap)
        d = item >> shift
        state = item & state_mask
        if d != dist[state]:
            continue

        u = state >> k
        if u == target:
            return d

        mask = state & mask_all

        if offers[u]:
            for zbit, price in offers[u]:
                if not (mask & zbit):
                    nstate = state | zbit
                    nd = d + price
                    if nd < dist[nstate]:
                        dist[nstate] = nd
                        heappush(heap, (nd << shift) | nstate)

        for v, cost, zbit in adj[u]:
            nd = d if (mask & zbit) else d + cost
            nstate = (v << k) | mask
            if nd < dist[nstate]:
                dist[nstate] = nd
                heappush(heap, (nd << shift) | nstate)

    return -1
